releaseNotes:
• Anti-Task-Kill & Recents Swipe Protection: Swiping Orbis from the Recent Apps screen will no longer kill the floating sidebar handle
• Overlay Watchdog Keep-Alive: Added auto-resurrection watchdog that brings the edge handle back within 500ms if ever killed by system Low Memory Killer
• 1-Tap Battery Saver Exemption: Prompt and Settings card to allow 'Unrestricted' background battery usage so Android doesn't kill the sidebar in Doze mode
• Foreground Notification Hardening: Notification channel upgraded with 'Restart Handle' action for instant recovery
• Safe Edge Handle Attachment: Improved edge handle view attachment safeguards across screen orientation and display lock events
